title: Embracing Swift concurrency
description: Join us to learn the core Swift concurrency concepts. Concurrency helps you improve app responsiveness and performance, and Swift is designed to make asynchronous and concurrent code easier to write correctly. We’ll cover the steps you need to take an app through from single-threaded to concurrent. We’ll also help you determine how and when to make the best use of Swift concurrency features – whether it’s making your code more asynchronous, moving it to the background, or sharing data across concurrent tasks.

resources.title: The Swift Programming Language: Concurrency
resources.description: The chapter of the Language Guide in The Swift Programming Language that covers asynchronous and parallel code, including asynchronous functions (async/await), asynchronous sequences (AsyncSequence), async let, tasks, task groups, and actors.
